name: QuickSync for WooCommerce
author: quicksync

sections.description:
Sell across more channels. Spend less time updating stock.

QuickSync connects WooCommerce with Shopify, Square, Amazon, Etsy, eBay and other supported sales channels. Manage your connected stores from QuickSync and keep inventory aligned as you sell online and in store.

Keep inventory in sync

When inventory syncing is enabled, stock changes in an aligned store flow to its connected counterparts. Keep matching products up to date across your channels, helping reduce overselling and manual stock adjustments.

Update products from one source

Choose a source store for product updates. With product syncing enabled, QuickSync copies supported product details, images and prices to your connected stores according to your settings.

Connect WooCommerce in a few steps

Install the plugin, open WooCommerce → QuickSync, and connect your store. Sign in or create a QuickSync account, complete setup, and enable the syncs you need. Connecting the plugin does not automatically start syncing.

Stay informed from WordPress

  • Connect without manually copying API keys.
  • Check your store’s connection status.
  • Find common connection issues with built-in diagnostics.
  • Access connection logs and support information.

A QuickSync account is required. Syncing is managed by the hosted QuickSync service. Available features depend on your plan, connected platforms and sync settings. Products are matched across stores by SKU.

External services

This plugin connects to QuickSync (https://app.quicksync.pro) so the store can be paired and managed.

  • POST /store/woocommerce/plugin/handoff/ — sends the site URL and a WooCommerce REST key the plugin created locally, and receives a connect link.
  • GET /store/woocommerce/plugin/handoff/{id}/ — the plugin polls this after you finish sign-in, to store the connection token. The poll secret is sent only as the X-QuickSync-Handoff-Secret header.
  • POST /store/woocommerce/plugin/claim/ — pairing-code fallback; same data as handoff.
  • GET /store/woocommerce/plugin/status/ — connection state, plan name, and whether the REST key still works.
  • POST /store/woocommerce/plugin/status/ — only if you tell the plugin this site is a copy or that the site moved.

Unconfirmed handoff rows and the WooCommerce REST keys they carry are hard-deleted after 15 minutes. A new Connect click revokes the previous unused key before creating another.

The connection token is stored in the WordPress options table (quicksync_connection). WordPress has no secret store. Status screens show only a masked token (qs_plugin_••••1234).

Terms of service: https://quicksync.pro/terms/
Privacy policy: https://quicksync.pro/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install QuickSync for WooCommerce from Plugins → Add New, or upload the zip.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → QuickSync and click Connect QuickSync.
  4. Sign in or create a QuickSync account in the new tab.
  5. Return here. Syncing stays off until you enable it in QuickSync.
sections.faq:
Does connecting start syncing?

No. Connect your store, complete setup in QuickSync, and enable syncing when you are ready.

Do I have to paste an API key?

No. The plugin creates a WooCommerce REST key against your administrator account and sends it to QuickSync. If you already have a pairing code from the QuickSync dashboard, paste that instead.

Can I still connect without this plugin?

Yes. The existing WooCommerce authorise flow on quicksync.pro still works.

What happens if I clone this site to staging?

The plugin records the site URL at connect. If the URL changes, it pauses and asks whether this is a copy or a move.

Where are the logs?

WooCommerce → Status → Logs, source quicksync-for-woocommerce.

Will uninstalling wipe the connection?

No, unless you opt into a purge before uninstalling.
